_comment: Wave D-1 (#155): Xif's 'Cunning Crafts' stall. Voice: friendly, distractible, cost-minded, 'I am a City Gnoll, if anyone asks.' Shop is haggle-FALSE (Pallass civic doctrine -- posted prices, final). Sells components + a potion. ONE Saliss banter name-drop (the 'naked lunatic' line), NEVER near Onieva or identity. His [Perfect Reduction]/[Poison Immunity] stay dialogue color, never player grants.

hub.speaker: Xif
hub.text: Cunning Crafts, best on the tier. I am a City Gnoll, if anyone asks. Prices are posted and prices are final. This is Pallass. We do not haggle here. What do you need?

text_variants.text: The repeat customer. I like repeat customers. What now?

options.text: A twist of mineral salts. (7 gold)
Who is the best alchemist in Pallass?

options._comment: #513 ledger_eats_first TALK route, moved here from pallass_market_clerk (gates and effects unchanged). APPENDED LAST and requires-hidden, so the six-row hub test_mana_potion_catalog and the caster journey pin is unchanged for anyone outside the quest.
options.text: That crate on the forge landing. The regulator.

bought.speaker: Xif
bought.text: Sold, at the posted price. Prices are final. You will run out. Come back when you do. The shop opens at the first bell.

regulator.speaker: Xif
regulator.text: My ink, yes? I sold that workshop a jar. It sings near mana-stone if nothing is between them. Lead is between them. Tell the smith two fingers of lead. This advice is not on the board, so it is free.

options.text: Two fingers of lead. I'll tell her.

regulator_done.speaker: Xif
regulator_done.text: Two fingers. With one, it still sings a little, and then people come back to my stall to complain about it.

banter.speaker: Xif
banter.text: Me, obviously. The only alchemist in this city better than me is a naked lunatic, and he does not keep regular hours. Now, was there something you wanted to buy, or are we only flattering me?
